text.tspan: Share of people who think others can be trusted vs. taken advantage of
Share of respondents who agree with the statement "Most people can be trusted" vs. the share who agree with
the statement "Most people would try to take advantage of you if they got a chance".
Agree "Most people would try to take advantage of you"
Share agreeing "most people can be trusted"

tspan.tspan: We include the most recent data available for both questions. In most countries this corresponds to wave 4, 1999-2004. Where data for

text.tspan: 2014 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 1999 and 2022 is shown instead.
